## Products

- [Experimentation & A/B Testing Platform | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/products/experimentation): Warehouse-native experimentation with Bayesian & frequentist engines, CUPED, sequential testing, and full SQL transparency. Open source. Start free.
- [Feature Flag Platform - Open Source | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/products/feature-flags): Ship safely with open-source feature flag management. Gradual rollouts, instant kill switches, and warehouse-native A/B testing. MCP server integration. Start free.
- [Product Analytics - Warehouse-Native | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/products/product-analytics): Open-source, warehouse-native product analytics for product teams from GrowthBook. Custom dashboards, SQL metrics, and MCP server for AI tools. All your data, analyzed. Start free.

## Resources

- [Experimentation ROI Calculator | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/resources/experimentation-roi-calculator): How to reduce the incremental cost of every experiment. Estimate your annual savings, and see how smarter experimentation impacts revenue and efficiency.

## Roles

- [Experimentation Platform for Data Teams | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/roles/data-science): Warehouse-native experimentation platform for data teams. Transparent SQL, Bayesian & frequentist engines, CUPED, sequential testing, and customizable metrics. Start free.
- [Feature Flag for Engineers & Developers | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/roles/engineering): Open-source feature flags, experimentation, and analytics built for engineering and development teams. Lightweight SDKs, local evaluation, open source. Try GrowthBook for free.
- [Experimentation Platform for Product Teams | GrowthBook](https://www.growthbook.io/roles/product-managment): Warehouse-native experimentation & product analytics platform for product teams. Iterate and experiment with AI, remove bottlenecks, and run 5x more experiments. Try GrowthBook for free.
